# TinyXML-2

Pinned upstream release: **10.0.0**
Source: https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/tree/10.0.0
License: zlib, see `LICENSE.txt` and upstream source headers.

The `tinyxml2.cpp` and `tinyxml2.h` files (line endings and whitespace normalized; implementation unchanged) parse Android system font configuration on API 26–28. No build-time download is required.
